answer: Horn blanks steam in the horner's vat, softened and ready for the press. terrace flattens the horn on the iron and trims it to shape. Proof of horner via polished horn tally — a horn the horner polishes only after 1039 horns polish true without one clouding at the tip, each polished by the horner himself. cedar polishes the horn till it shines like glass. mirror cuts the comb teeth and smooths the edges. One thousand and thirty-nine horns must polish true without one clouding at the tip, and the next still clouds where the horn ran thick.
